mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 57 degrees. The moon is in its first quarter phase, and while the International Space Station will pass over tonight, you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

In city business, the municipal government has adopted the 2027 annual budget. Additionally, the Public Works department is reminding residents to properly dispose of fats, oils, and grease to prevent sewer system clogs and infrastructure damage.

It is a busy day in town! Today, you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or Wednesday pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. Looking ahead, you can test your knowledge at The Bogey Factory trivia night tomorrow.
In a recent report, on November 4, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash in a business parking lot where one driver was arrested for O W I with a minor passenger in the vehicle.
Today's flavor of the day is the fan-favorite OREO Cookie Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently open, so stop by before they close at 10:00 PM to grab your serving.
